items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: I knew, I jammed with her. You know, sat down and had some talks with her, you know, during her jazz time.

ctx.x: That's good. And other trumpet players besides Roy, like Cootie

Oh yeah. Cootie. Cootie with Duke. He was, he and I was good friends. Cootie was good. He had his style. I didn't know about I never, nobody plungers until I heard Cootie. Dud used to do a lot of plungers after that too. I remember the time when Ivie Anderson was singing with Duke Ellington and they played the Savoy. Cootie, Freddie Jenkins, I think was in his section, I can't think of the other trumpet player. And, we were on this stand and they were on that stand.
